svg.text: Interpolation qualifiers on a varying (GLSL ES 3.00)
the primitive when MSAA is on,
so edge pixels do not extrapolate
Integer varyings must be flat. There is no noperspective qualifier in GLSL ES.
Qualifier syntax: flat out vec3 vId; in the vertex shader and flat in vec3 vId; in the fragment shader.
The qualifier must match on both sides of the link or the program fails to link.
